purpose: Fresh end-to-end proof of rendered web navigation, semantic extraction, artifact persistence, and independent release verification from one plain-language goal.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://www.python.org/downloads/. Determine the latest stable Python 3 release shown on the page. Save a full-page screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS.png and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS_RESULT.json containing source_url, final_url, page_title, latest_stable_python3, and observed_text_evidence. Finally independently verify from the official Python downloads page, without trusting the browser extraction, that the claimed latest_stable_python3 string is present and corresponds to the current stable Python 3 release shown there.
